summary: For each (σ, h) build M_{σ,h} from the divisibility of a diagonal matrix with entries ρ_e(θ) = θ^{1/p^e} (p^e-th roots of θ in 𝔬): its rows are chosen (`IndexDvd.of_det_dvd`) so that the couplings with the partner rows vanish modulo θ, at the cost of a determinant that divides the product A_{σ,h} of the selected roots (det M_{σ,h} ∣ A_{σ,h}, hence |A_{σ,h}| ≤ |det M_{σ,h}|). The exponents of |θ| in the products A_{σ,h} add up exactly to the coupling counts (an equality of exponents, valid also for θ = 0).

steps.claim: Unfold `couplingCount` and name its parts t, r, D (columns of height one outside ev, other columns, and their boxes).
steps.lean: delta couplingCount; extract_lets t r D

steps.claim: For every k choose p^k-th roots ρ_k(x) ∈ 𝔬 of every x ∈ 𝔬 (𝔬 is integrally closed in the algebraically closed ℂ_p).
steps.lean: choose ρ hρ using (@IsAIC.exists_pow_eq (valRingCp p) _ (.of_isIntegrallyClosedIn ℂ_[p]) <| p ^ ·)

steps.claim: A(h, e, σ, b, s): the bookkeeping predicate deciding, for a coupling (e, σ) seen from the side b, whether a row with flag s gets a root of θ (h = 1 rows outside ev; comparison of t, r, D with their p^e-th parts).
steps.lean:
let A h e σ b s := (h = 1 → cond b σ (pr e σ) ∉ ev ∧ s = b) ∧ (ite (s ∧ h ≠ 1)
    ((D σ : ℝ) / p ^ e ≤ D (pr e σ)) (s = b → (t σ : ℝ) / p ^ e ≤ r (pr e σ) + t (pr e σ)) ↔ b)

steps.claim: For every (τ, h): a matrix M_{τ,h} over 𝔬 whose determinant divides the product A_{τ,h} of the diagonal entries ρ_{e or 0}(θ) over the couplings selected by A (hM: det M_{τ,h} ∣ A_{τ,h}), with hA: each selected row of M times the (Frobenius-twisted) partner data is divisible by the corresponding root of θ (`IndexDvd.of_det_dvd` applied to the diagonal matrix with determinant A_{τ,h}, whose image is the receiving module).
steps.lean:
choose M hM v _ hA using fun τ h ↦ IndexDvd.of_det_dvd (det_diagonal (d :=
    fun ((e : S), σ, b, (o : Option (Fin h))) ↦ ite (cond b σ (pr e σ) = τ ∧
    A h e σ b o.isSome) (ρ (ite b e 0) θ) 1)).dvd le_rfl _ (fun j (e, σ, b, o) ↦ o.elim (∑ a,
    ite b (ρ e (Y (pr e σ) a 0)) (Y σ a 0 ^ p ^ ↑e) * Y τ a j) (diagonal 1 j)) (by simp)

steps.claim: Take these M; it remains (i) the determinant bound and (ii) the vanishing of couplings.
steps.lean: use M, ?_, fun g _ j σ h i h' _ _ ↦ ?_

steps.claim: (i): bound each |det M_{τ,h}| from below by the norm of the product of the selected roots.

|A_{τ,h}| ≤ |det M_{τ,h}| for the product A_{τ,h} of the selected roots: det M_{τ,h} divides A_{τ,h} in 𝔬 (hM of step 4), and in a valuation ring x ∣ y implies |y| ≤ |x| (`Valuation.Integers.le_of_dvd`). (The written type is ‖(_ : valRingCp p)‖ ≤ ‖(M τ h).det‖ with the hole filled by A_{τ,h}; the recorded typed_fact is only its first fragment, cut at the line break.)
steps.lean:
show ‖(_ :
    valRingCp p)‖ ≤ ‖(M τ h).det‖ from (integer.integers _).le_of_dvd (hM ..)]

steps.claim: Rewrite the product of norms of roots as one power of |θ|: products become sums of exponents.
steps.lean:
simp (disch := intros; positivity) only [← rpow_mul_natCast, sum_mul, norm_prod,
    ← pow_boole, norm_pow, fun e ↦

show ‖ρ e θ‖ = ‖θ‖ ^ (p ^ e : ℝ)⁻¹ by
      simp [← congr(‖$(hρ e θ)‖), ← rpow_natCast_mul]

steps.claim: Collect the exponents as a sum over e ∈ S, σ and the flags.

Reduce the inequality between the two powers of |θ| to the equality of their exponents, term by term (`congr!`; the minima of the coupling count were split by `min_def`). An inequality of exponents would not do: |θ| ≤ 1, and for a base in [0, 1] a larger exponent gives a smaller power.

In each case of the bookkeeping predicate, the exponent of |θ| contributed by the selected roots (the powers 1/p^e of the roots, counted with the column counts) equals the corresponding part min(t_σ/p^e, r_{σ′} + t_{σ′}) + r_σ/p^e + min(D_σ/p^e, D_{σ′}) of the coupling count, after the minima are split (case split, sums over ranges); being an equality of exponents, it also covers θ = 0.
steps.lean:
split_ifs <;> simp [*, A, ite_and, Fintype.sum_sigma] <;> simp +zetaDelta [sum_range,
    sum_div, ← sum_add_distrib] <;> clear * - θ <;> grind [Nat.cast_eq_one]

steps.claim: (ii): for R, g with g(θ) = 0, j ∈ S, σ, h, i, h′, i′ outside the exempted cases the coupling vanishes.
steps.lean:
have D h b i o (_ : A h j σ b o.isSome) :=
    congr(g ($(hA (cond b σ (pr j σ)) h i) (j, σ, b, o) ^ p ^ ite b j.1 0)).symm
  simp [↓Option.forall, -pow_ite, @sum_comm n, hρ, mul_pow,
    @mul_sum n, mul_left_comm (M ..), ← mul_sum, ← map_pow _ (ρ ..), sum_pow_char_pow] at D
  obtain ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩, H, ⟨⟩⟩ : ∃ b s, A (b.rec h' h) j σ b s ∧ 1 = s.rec (b.rec h h') 1; simp; lia
  repeat simp [sum_pow_char_pow, mul_pow, mul_assoc, mul_comm (∑ _, _), ← mul_sum, *, dotProduct]

steps.claim: D: applying g to the divisibility of hA, raised to the power p^{(j if b else 0)}: each selected row pairing is g of a multiple of a root of θ raised to that power, i.e. of θ, hence 0.
steps.lean:
have D h b i o (_ : A h j σ b o.isSome) :=
    congr(g ($(hA (cond b σ (pr j σ)) h i) (j, σ, b, o) ^ p ^ ite b j.1 0)).symm

steps.claim: Rewrite D with the Frobenius in characteristic p (sums of p^j-th powers) and ρ^{p^e} = θ.
steps.lean:
simp [↓Option.forall, -pow_ite, @sum_comm n, hρ, mul_pow,
    @mul_sum n, mul_left_comm (M ..), ← mul_sum, ← map_pow _ (ρ ..), sum_pow_char_pow] at D

steps.claim: There are a side b and a flag s satisfying the bookkeeping predicate A for the heights (h, h′) in the order given by b, with matching row counts (from the non-exemption hypothesis; `simp`, `lia`).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩, H, ⟨⟩⟩ : ∃ b s, A (b.rec h' h) j σ b s ∧ 1 = s.rec (b.rec h h') 1; simp; lia
steps.typed_fact: ∃ b s, A (b.rec h' h) j σ b s ∧ 1 = s.rec (b.rec h h') 1

steps.claim: The coupling is the case of D for these b, s; expand dot products and Frobenius powers.
steps.lean: repeat simp [sum_pow_char_pow, mul_pow, mul_assoc, mul_comm (∑ _, _), ← mul_sum, *, dotProduct]
